bookable_off: Mentioned on the phone, but the caller is told a person will arrange it.
bookable_on: Offered on the phone and booked into a free slot without asking anyone.
confirm_remove: Remove “{name}” from the catalogue? The assistant stops quoting it at once.
dialog_note: One line the assistant can quote, book and price.
empty_fields_body: Those two exist because a phone system cannot recognise a caller without them. Every other column is one you define — a customer number, a consent date, whatever your work needs.
empty_preview_body: These sentences are generated from the catalogue, so an empty catalogue produces none. Asked what you offer or what it costs, the assistant says it cannot say and offers to have somebody ring back — that is all it can honestly do.
empty_services_body: Until something is here the assistant can take messages but cannot book anything, and any question about what you offer or what it costs gets “I don’t know”.
error_body: The interface is running, but the server refused the request. Check that it is up, then try again.
fields_note: The columns your contact list has. Two of them are fixed because a phone system cannot work without them; everything else is yours to define, and each field says separately whether the assistant may read it out.
fields_waiting: Contact fields are not built yet. Today a contact has a name and a number, and the assistant reads out neither more nor less than the catalogue.
form_price_note: The amount the assistant quotes. It is stored exactly as typed.
form_says_placeholder: We come to you, usually within the same week.
intro: What you sell and what you record about the people who buy it. Tel-Agent ships with none of this — the assistant only ever speaks from what you put here.
offline_body: The catalogue below was last read before the connection went, and nothing typed now will be saved.
preview_waiting: The preview is generated from the catalogue and the contact fields together, so it arrives with them.
save_failed: Could not save that. Nothing was changed.
services_note: A service switched off still shows in your own calendar — it just stops being offered on the phone. The assistant then says it exists but has to be arranged with a person.
title: Catalogue
